_info: MERP-inspired damage tables. Each weapon type has entries per hit tier. Engine picks one at random.

fumble.text: The spear slips on wet ground. You stumble forward, exposed.
Overcommitted — the shaft cracks against his shield. You're open.
He catches the haft and shoves. You hit the dirt.

miss.text: He sidesteps. The point cuts only air.
Too slow. He reads the thrust and twists away.
The spear goes wide. He doesn't even flinch.

glancing.text: The point grazes his arm. First blood — yours.
A shallow cut across the thigh. He limps but fights on.
The tip catches leather. He grunts. Not enough.

solid.text: The spear catches him below the ribs. He staggers back.
Clean thrust to the shoulder. His weapon arm drops.
You drive the point through his guard. Blood on the shaft.

critical.text: Through the shield. He screams and falls.
Pinned to the earth. The others freeze.
The spear takes him in the neck. Silence.

devastating.text: Straight through the chest. He doesn't make a sound. Even your own men step back.
The spear sings through the air and finds its mark. A perfect thrust. The enemy line breaks.

fumble.text: The swing goes wild. The weight pulls you off balance.
You miss and the club hits the ground. The shock runs up your arm.
He ducks. You spin with the momentum, back exposed.

miss.text: Too slow. He steps inside your reach.
The club whistles past his head. Close, but air.
He blocks with his forearm. Holds. Grins.

glancing.text: A glancing blow to the shoulder. He winces but keeps coming.
The club clips his hip. He stumbles. Not down.
A crack against his forearm. Something might be broken. He switches hands.

solid.text: Full swing to the ribs. You hear something crack. He doubles over.
The club connects with his jaw. Teeth and blood. He drops.
A heavy blow to the thigh. His leg buckles. He's on one knee.

critical.text: The club hits his temple. His eyes go empty before he falls.
You bring it down on his collarbone. The snap echoes. He crumples.
Across the face. He spins, hits the ground, doesn't move.

devastating.text: One swing. His skull caves. The sound is wrong. Everyone stops. Even the enemy.
The blow lifts him off his feet. He lands broken. Your warriors roar.

fumble.text: The blade catches on his armour. He wrenches it sideways. Your wrist screams.
You slash at air. He's already behind you.
The grip slips. Wet hands. He sees it.

miss.text: He parries. Sparks. Your arm rings from the impact.
Quick cut, but he's quicker. Blade meets nothing.
He leans back just enough. The edge passes a finger's width from his throat.

glancing.text: A cut across his forearm. Not deep, but it bleeds freely.
The blade nicks his cheek. He blinks. Keeps fighting.
You open his side — shallow. He presses a hand against it.

solid.text: The blade bites deep into his sword arm. His grip loosens.
A clean slash across his belly. He folds. Still breathing.
Under his guard, into the ribs. He gasps and steps back.

critical.text: Across the throat. Fast. He reaches for what's already gone.
The blade finds the gap between neck and shoulder. Deep. He drops instantly.
You reverse the cut and drive it in. He looks surprised. Then nothing.

devastating.text: Two cuts. One across, one down. He was dead after the first. The second was for his friends to see.
The blade moves like it knows where to go. Through leather, through skin, through bone. His knees fold. The name of this sword will be remembered.

fumble.text: The axe buries itself in a root. You wrench it free too late.
The head glances off his shield and the haft cracks. Still usable. Barely.
Too wide. He steps inside. You can smell him.

miss.text: He ducks. The axe takes a branch off the tree behind him.
The swing is heavy and slow. He sees it coming.
His shield catches the blow. The impact jars your arms.

glancing.text: The axe catches his arm. A gash. He switches his grip.
A chip of his shield splinters off. He felt that.
The edge scrapes across his ribs. Leather saved him. Mostly.

solid.text: The axe bites into his shoulder. He screams. His arm hangs.
Through the shield. Through the arm behind it. He falls.
A heavy chop into his thigh. Bone. He's done.

critical.text: The axe cleaves his shield in two. The second swing finds flesh.
One overhead swing. He raises his arms. It doesn't help.
Into the neck. The axe sticks. You have to brace a foot to pull it free.

devastating.text: The axe splits him from shoulder to sternum. No one speaks. The sound carries across the field.
One blow. He comes apart. The axe is warm in your hands and the enemy breaks.

fumble.text: The string snaps back. Your fingers bleed. No shot.
The arrow veers wild. It hits a tree. Or worse — someone on your side.
You fumble the nock. The arrow drops. He's already charging.

miss.text: The arrow passes a hand's width from his face. He doesn't notice.
It thuds into the dirt at his feet. He looks up at you.

glancing.text: The arrow catches his arm. He snaps the shaft off and keeps coming.
Through the ear. A finger lower and he'd be dead.
It skims his ribs. Blood, but he's still standing.

solid.text: The arrow hits his chest. He sits down slowly, confused.
Into the thigh. He falls. Tries to crawl. Can't.
Through the hand and into his belly. He won't pull it out.

critical.text: Through the eye. He drops mid-stride. The men behind him trip over the body.
The arrow takes him in the throat. He grabs it. He shouldn't have.
Center of the chest. He looks down at the fletching. Falls backward.

devastating.text: One hundred paces. Through leather, through rib, through heart. He was dead before the sound of the bow reached him. Silence on the field.
The arrow pins him to the tree behind. His feet leave the ground. His friends run.

fumble.text: The ashkin swings wild, loses balance. Your warriors jeer.
His crude spear snaps on your shield. He stares at the stump.

miss.text: He lunges. You step aside. Too slow, too predictable.
The blow glances off your armour. You barely felt it.

glancing.text: His club catches your forearm. A bruise. You've had worse.
A crude blade opens a cut on your thigh. Stings.

solid.text: The ashkin drives a sharpened bone into your side. Pain blooms.
His club hits your ribs. Something cracks. You taste iron.
A stone-tipped spear catches your shoulder. Deep. Your arm goes numb.

critical.text: He's faster than he looks. The blade opens your face. Blood in your eyes.
The blow hits your helmet. The world rings. You're on one knee.
He tackles you. You hit the ground. His teeth are near your throat.

devastating.text: The ashkin chief buries his war-pick in your shield arm. Bone snaps. You hear your own scream from far away.
Three of them hit you at once. You go down under grey skin and stone blades. Your warriors scream your name.

strong: Your warriors press forward. Shield against shield. They smell victory.
The line holds firm. War-cries echo through the trees.
Your men fight as one. The enemy has nowhere to go.
holding: The line holds. Grunts, iron on wood. No one gives ground.
Steady. Your men do their work. Sweat and blood and patience.
The formation bends but doesn't break. Good men.
wavering: A man on your left stumbles. The line bends. Eyes flick to you.
Someone screams behind you. The rhythm breaks. Fear is contagious.
Your warriors bunch together. Too tight. Discipline is slipping.
breaking: Thorvald is down. Two men step back. The line is gone.
They're running. Not all of them — but enough. The shield wall is memory.
A boy drops his spear and runs. No one blames him. Others follow.
